rv.q: Musical theatre’s graveyard is littered with grand scale projects at which producers threw their millions and ended up with a flop. Thankfully the opposite is also true, where an unlikely premise, when infused with heart, enthusiasm, talent and energy, can result in a surprising and uplifting success.
Good as all these songs are, there are too many here – although I'd be sad to lose bonkers tangents like the operatic panic over a bee.
Why Am I So Single? feels somewhat flabby.
When you're playing a hallowed venue like the Garrick, people expect a bit more polish.
"Why Am I So Single?" has arrived in the West End with no tryout in which its major structural problems could have been addressed.
I defy anyone not to have a massively enjoyable time at this musical.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this Gen Z-focused musical from the SIX creators, with some finding it uplifting and hilarious while others criticize its flabby structure and lack of polish compared to their previous hit.
